title: Gigabit Ethernet PHY circuit: ESP32-S31 (QFN80) RGMII -> YT8531DC-CA -> HR911130C

sources.s31_ds: https://documentation.espressif.com/esp32-s31_datasheet_en.html (Table 2-1 pin list, Table 2-3 IO MUX, Table 2-8)

summary.phy_address: 0 (all PHYAD straps at internal pull-down; FW auto-detects with phy_addr=-1)
summary.rgmii_io_voltage: 3.3 V (CFG_EXT=1 via R216, CFG_LDO[1:0]=00 via R214/R215, DVDD_RGMII = PHY_3V3); matches ESP32-S31 VDDPST_1 3.0-3.6 V (GPIO8-19)
summary.rgmii_delays: PHY adds both delays and the ESP32 adds none. RX: RXDLY strap = 1 (internal pull-up) gives 2 ns, and FW also sets ext 0xA001 bit 8 (Rxc_dly_en). TX: FW writes ext 0xA003 [7:4] = [3:0] = 13, i.e. about 13 x 150 ps = 1.95 ns on TX_CLK for both 1000M and 10/100M. PCB clock traces get no extra delay; length-match each group.
summary.clock: 25 MHz crystal on the PHY. The PHY does not take a ref clock from the ESP32, so GPIO35 is not used.
summary.supply: PHY_3V3 comes from the board +3V3 through FB201. YT8531DC draws about 226 mA typical and 250 mA max at 3.3 V (datasheet Tables 103/106; the internal 1.1 V LDO is fed from DVDD33). Budget 260 mA including LEDs. The internal LDO supplies PHY_VDDL (1.1 V); no external 1.1 V regulator.
summary.reset: GPIO7 drives RESET_N, with a 4.7k pull-up (R219). IDF generic PHY holds reset low for 10 ms; the datasheet needs >= 10 ms low and >= 10 ms after power is stable.

rails.+3V3: board digital 3.3 V (AMS1117-3.3 per PART_SELECTION slot 12a)
rails.PHY_3V3: +3V3 after FB201; feeds AVDD33 (11,40), DVDD33 (29), DVDD_RGMII (28), pull-ups
rails.PHY_VDDL: 1.1 V from YT8531DC LDO_O pin 30; feeds AVDDL (3,8,38), DVDDL (21). Do not load it externally.
rails.GND_CHASSIS: RJ45 shield + HR911130C P10; joined to GND only via R222 (0R) / C216 (DNP)

NOT on the CoreBoard: its ETH_PHY_RST goes straight to GPIO7 with no resistor or cap. The datasheet says 'Requires an external pull-up resistor', so we add one. Firmware (IDF generic PHY) holds reset low for 10 ms and then releases it.

Chip-side centre-tap decoupling. The HR911130C ties all 4 CTs to P1, so one cap replaces CoreBoard C65/C66/C67/C69 (0.1uF/50V each). The YT8531 is voltage-mode: the CT must not go to 3.3 V.

rgmii: 50 ohm single-ended over an unbroken GND plane. Keep all 12 lines short: put the PHY within about 25-40 mm of ESP32 GPIO8-19 (QFN80 pins 14-26, on one side of the package).

Length-match within each group: TXD0-3 + TX_CTL to TX_CLK, and RXD0-3 + RX_CTL to RX_CLK, to +/-1.3 mm (about 8 ps). Do not add a delay serpentine on the clocks, because the PHY adds the 2 ns internally.
Space the clocks (ETH_TX_CLK / PHY_RX_CLK, 125 MHz) at least 3x the trace width from other lines, keep them away from the RF section and the TCXO, and avoid vias on them.
Series 33R at the driving end: TX resistors at the ESP32, RX resistors at the PHY.
mdi: 100 ohm differential pairs PHY pins 1-10 -> J201 pins 2-9. Match P/N within a pair to 0.15 mm. Pair-to-pair matching is not critical (keep within about 10 mm). Keep the pairs as short as possible, ideally < 50 mm.
J201 pin order: MDI1 sits on pins 4 and 7, which straddle MDI2 on pins 5 and 6. One of these pairs must change layer (2 vias per line, same for P and N) or be routed under the jack body.
No stubs. Keep 3x spacing between pairs and away from RGMII, the crystal and the RF section.
magjack: The magnetics and Bob Smith network are inside the jack, so pins 1-9 can be referenced to the logic GND plane up to the jack pins.

GND_CHASSIS (shield tabs + pin 10) gets its own copper island under the front (cable) half of the jack. Leave >= 2 mm clearance to logic GND/signals (isolation 1500-2250 V). Join it to GND only at R222/C216.
Keep logic-GND copper and all signals out from under the front of the jack (the shield/cable area).
Dia 3.25 mm holes are NPTH plastic pegs. Dia 1.63 mm holes are shield PTH. Dia 1.02 mm holes are LED pins. Dia 0.89 mm holes are signal pins.
phy: EPAD 3.7x3.7 mm: 3x3 to 4x4 thermal vias (0.3 mm) into GND. Typical dissipation is about 0.75 W; at theta_JA 33 C/W that is about a 25 C rise.

Put each 100 nF cap right at its pin (pins 3/8/38/21/30 on PHY_VDDL; 11/40/28/29 on PHY_3V3). Put the 10 uF bulk caps at pins 28/29. Run the PHY_VDDL trace from pin 30 to the AVDDL/DVDDL pins short and wide (>= 0.3 mm).
Put the crystal and its 15 pF caps right at pins 36/37 with a GND guard ring, and route no other traces under the crystal.
RBIAS resistor at pin 39, with a short return to GND.
